current_private_state.note: Private operational state is written through the locally synced Google Drive folder and read back from the local filesystem on Gene's PC before consequential reliance (the claude.ai Drive connector cannot read this folder). This is private operational state, not canonical governance.

rule: Git exposes only the minimum direct locator for the private operational state. Public Git remains canonical for governance/specification. Private operational payloads remain private. Storage transitions require integrity, coverage, access-control, and independent read-back verification before activation.
